title: Why Restrict the Domain?
text:
A quadratic function like $y = x^2$ is NOT one-to-one over all real numbers (it fails the horizontal line test).

By restricting to $x \geq 0$, we only take the right half of the parabola, making it one-to-one and invertible.

title: Finding the Inverse
text:
Starting with $y = x^2 - 4$:

1. Swap $x$ and $y$: $x = y^2 - 4$
2. Add 4: $x + 4 = y^2$
3. Take square root: $y = \pm\sqrt{x+4}$

title: Choose the Correct Root
text:
Since the original domain was $x \geq 0$, the range of the inverse must also be $y \geq 0$.

Which root do we choose?
